Customization.description: Studio B AcuOps — Audit Trail (SQL View + DAC + GI)

Sql.Name: CreateUsrAuditTrailView
Sql.CDATA: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.views WHERE name = 'UsrAuditTrailView') BEGIN EXEC(' CREATE VIEW dbo.UsrAuditTrailView AS SELECT ah.CompanyID, ah.BatchID, ah.ChangeID, ah.ScreenID, ah.UserID, u.Username, ah.ChangeDate, CASE ah.Operation WHEN 1 THEN ''Insert'' WHEN 2 THEN ''Update'' WHEN 3 THEN ''Delete'' ELSE ''Unknown ('' + CAST(ah.Operation AS nvarchar(10)) + '')'' END AS OperationDesc, ah.TableName, REPLACE( CAST(ah.CombinedKey AS nvarchar(MAX)) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, NCHAR(0), ''|'' ) AS CombinedKeyDisplay, REPLACE( CAST(ah.ModifiedFields AS nvarchar(MAX)) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, NCHAR(0), ''|'' ) AS ModifiedFieldsDisplay FROM AuditHistory ah LEFT JOIN Users u ON ah.UserID = u.PKID AND ah.CompanyID = u.CompanyID ') END

Sql.Name: InstallStudioBAuditTrailGI
